title.narrative: Activity under preparation Placeholder support measures 2025

description.narrative: Contract related to: Placeholder support measures 2025 - This Action aims to fund:1.     A Cooperation Facility for Myanmar for the period 2025-2027, providing the EU Delegation to Myanmar with the possibility to finance small-scale activities that are needed for the NDICI-Global Europe, and particularly of the three priority areas for Myanmar;2.      The implementation of Strategic Communication activities designed to raise awareness, understanding and perception of the EU and its partnership with the Myanmar people in line with the aforementioned priorities. Strategic Communication campaigns will serve to position the EU as a trusted and reliable partner of reference for the Myanmar people;3.      Measures in favour of civil society providing targeted support to civil society in addition to mainstreamed engagement with civil society (and, where applicable, with NGOs) along the aforementioned priority areas.The Overall Objective of this action is to reinforce the efficiency, performance, impact and visibility of EU cooperation in Myanmar, in line with EU¿s political, policy, development, and communication goals globally and in MyanmarThe Specific Objective of this action is to 1.Build inclusive and gender responsive support for the implementation of EU¿s cooperation priorities in Myanmar (Cooperation Facility ¿ Technical Assistance).2. Enhance the development and governance role of local civil society (including women¿s and human rights organizations) actors in the country, so that they can more efficiently provide general interest services and participate in different processes (Measures in Support of Civil Society);3. Measurably increased awareness, understanding and perception of the EU partnership in the country (Cooperation Facility ¿ Strategic Communication). The Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives are: 1.1 Reinforced efficiency, performance, evaluation, impact of EU cooperation in Myanmar, including cooperation with Team Europe partners; 2.1 Strengthened capacities of local civil society actors in the country, including NGOs and networks, grassroots organisations, youth and women¿s organisations;3.1 Targeted campaigns and gender responsive communication activities are designed and implemented to make the EU more visible, relevant, and influential.
